basics.name: Carlos A. Aguila
basics.label: PhD Candidate in Bioengineering
basics.summary: PhD candidate in Bioengineering at the University of Pennsylvania. I build machine learning tools that extract clinically actionable information from intracranial EEG to improve surgical outcomes for drug-resistant epilepsy. NSF GRFP and NIH R01 Diversity Supplement awardee. Expected graduation Fall 2026.

work.name: Center for Neuroengineering and Therapeutics, University of Pennsylvania
work.summary: Advisors: Erin C. Conrad, MD & Brian Litt, MD. Dissertation: Mapping dynamic epileptic networks using spontaneous and evoked interictal EEG.
highlights: Time-series analysis of intracranial EEG: spike rates, multidien cycles, epileptic networks
ML models integrating interictal and ictal features to predict mesial temporal lobe epilepsy
Cortical stimulation pipeline characterizing epileptogenic networks from stimulation trials
Collaboration on ictal iEEG clustering via unsupervised deep learning

work.name: The Neural Stack / Neural Memos
